title: Working with the American Psychological Association on youth mental health and AI
summary: OpenAI与美国心理学会合作，共同推进基于证据的指导、资源和保障措施，以促进负责任的AI使用并关注青少年心理健康。
highlights: OpenAI and the American Psychological Association advance evidence-based guidance, resources, and safeguards for responsible AI use and youth mental health.
